note: Hand-labeled ground truth for extraction category accuracy evaluation. Labels follow the TSD-anchored definition: 'design' means verifiable from the Technical Specification Document alone (architecture, data flows, trust boundaries, protocol choices, encryption strategy, access control model, key management). Extend this set for broader coverage.

category_definitions.design: TSD-verifiable: architecture, data flows, trust boundaries, protocol/encryption strategy, access control model, key/secret management approach
category_definitions.code: Requires source code inspection: algorithm work factors, cookie flags, parameterized queries, output encoding specifics, OTP entropy
category_definitions.infrastructure: Requires ops/config audit: CI/CD, debug mode, HTTP header values, TLS cipher testing, dependency version checks
category_definitions.process: Requires organizational assessment: SDLC policy, threat modeling cadence, developer training, change management

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify the use of a secure software development lifecycle
items.rationale: Requires organizational SDLC policy assessment, not readable from a TSD

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify the use of threat modeling for every design change
items.rationale: Threat modeling cadence is a process/practice, not a TSD artifact

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that all user stories and features contain functional security constraints
items.rationale: Story-level security constraints are a development process requirement

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify documentation and justification of all the application's trust boundaries
items.rationale: Trust boundary documentation IS the TSD — directly verifiable from architecture diagrams

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify definition and security analysis of the application's high-level architecture
items.rationale: High-level architecture with security analysis is a core TSD section

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify implementation of centralized, simple security controls
items.rationale: Centralized security control placement is an architectural decision visible in TSD

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify availability of a secure coding checklist
items.rationale: Coding checklists are a process/organizational artifact

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify the use of unique or special low-privilege operating system accounts
items.rationale: OS-level account configuration is an infrastructure/ops concern

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that communications between application components are authenticated
items.rationale: Inter-component authentication is an architectural decision documented in TSD

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that the application uses a single vetted authentication mechanism
items.rationale: Choice of authentication mechanism is a design decision in TSD

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that trusted enforcement points enforce access control
items.rationale: Access control enforcement point placement (gateway, server-side) is architecture

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that there is an explicit policy for management of cryptographic keys
items.rationale: Key management policy/approach (key vault usage, rotation policy) is TSD-level

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that consumers of cryptographic services protect key material
items.rationale: How key material is protected by consuming components is an architectural concern

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify the application encrypts communications between components
items.rationale: Inter-component encryption strategy (e.g. mTLS) is a TSD-documented design decision

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that application components verify the authenticity of each side of a communication
items.rationale: Validating TLS certificates and chains is an implementation detail checked in code

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify the segregation of components of differing trust levels
items.rationale: Segregation via firewalls and API gateways is an infrastructure configuration

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that user set passwords are at least 12 characters in length
items.rationale: Password length enforcement is implemented in code; not visible in TSD

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that passwords submitted during account registration are checked against a set of breached passwords
items.rationale: Breach list checking is an implementation detail requiring source code review

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that anti-automation controls are effective at mitigating breached credential testing
items.rationale: Implementing soft lockouts and rate limiting logic requires code-level verification

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that if bcrypt is used, the work factor should be as large as verification server performance will allow, with a minimum of 10
items.rationale: bcrypt work factor is an implementation parameter requiring source code inspection

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that a system generated initial activation or recovery secret is not sent in clear text
items.rationale: Verifying recovery secret generation and dispatch logic requires code inspection

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that integration secrets do not rely on unchanging passwords
items.rationale: Policy that intra-service secrets avoid unchanging credentials is an architectural design decision

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify the application generates a new session token on user authentication
items.rationale: Session token regeneration is an implementation behavior requiring code review

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that cookie-based session tokens have the Secure attribute set
items.rationale: Cookie attribute flags are set in code; not verifiable from TSD

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that cookie-based session tokens have the HttpOnly attribute set
items.rationale: HttpOnly flag is a code-level cookie configuration

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that the application enforces access control rules on a trusted service layer
items.rationale: Access control enforcement layer placement is an architectural decision in TSD

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that sensitive data and APIs are protected against direct object reference attacks
items.rationale: IDOR protection requires code-level access checks on each resource

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that all input is validated using positive validation
items.rationale: Input validation logic is implemented in code; requires source code review

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that output encoding is relevant for the interpreter and context required
items.rationale: Output encoding specifics (HTML, JS, URL context) are code implementation details

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that serialized objects use integrity checks or are encrypted to prevent hostile object creation or data tampering
items.rationale: Checking integrity or encryption logic of serialized objects requires source code review

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that regulated private data is stored encrypted while at rest
items.rationale: What data is classified as regulated PII and how it is stored encrypted is TSD-level design

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that regulated health data is stored encrypted while at rest
items.rationale: Health data encryption at rest is a data classification and storage design decision

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that all cryptographic modules fail securely, and errors are handled in a way that does not enable Padding Oracle attacks
items.rationale: Cryptographic error handling is an implementation-level concern requiring code review

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that a secrets management solution such as a key vault is used to securely create, store, control access to and destroy secrets
items.rationale: Integration and usage of a secrets management solution like a key vault is an infrastructure deployment configuration

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that the application does not log credentials or payment details
items.rationale: Ensuring credentials are omitted from logs requires inspecting logging implementation in code

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that all authentication decisions are logged
items.rationale: Verifying that authentication decisions are effectively logged requires source code inspection

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that the application appropriately encodes user-supplied data to prevent log injection
items.rationale: Log injection prevention is an implementation detail requiring code review

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that a generic message is shown when an unexpected or security sensitive error occurs
items.rationale: Error message content is a code-level implementation detail

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify the application protects sensitive data from being cached in server components
items.rationale: Anti-caching for server components like load balancers is an infrastructure configuration

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that sensitive data is sent to the server in the HTTP message body or headers
items.rationale: How sensitive data is transmitted (body vs URL) is a code implementation decision

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that TLS is used for all client connectivity
items.rationale: Ensuring TLS is used without fallback requires server/infrastructure configuration

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that only strong cipher suites are enabled
items.rationale: Cipher suite configuration requires server/ops configuration audit, not TSD reading

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that connections to and from the server use trusted TLS certificates
items.rationale: Certificate trust verification is an infrastructure/deployment configuration

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that a code analysis tool can detect potentially malicious code
items.rationale: SAST/code analysis tool usage is a development process requirement

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that the application employs integrity protections, such as code signing or sub-resource integrity
items.rationale: Implementing subresource integrity (SRI) requires specific code-level attributes on script tags

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify the application will only process business logic flows in sequential step order
items.rationale: Enforcing sequential business logic steps requires source code inspection

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that the application will not accept large files that could fill up storage
items.rationale: Rejecting large files requires inspecting the file upload handling code

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that all application components use the same encodings and parsers
items.rationale: Using the same encodings and parsers across components requires source code verification

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that RESTful web services that utilize cookies are protected from Cross-Site Request Forgery
items.rationale: CSRF token implementation or SameSite enforcement is a code-level protection

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that the application build and deployment processes are performed in a secure and repeatable way
items.rationale: CI/CD automation and deployment scripts are infrastructure configurations

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that all components are up to date
items.rationale: Dependency version currency requires operational/dependency audit, not TSD review

items.requirement_excerpt: Verify that every HTTP response contains a Content-Type header specifying a safe character set
items.rationale: HTTP response header values are server/framework configuration, not TSD-level design
